description: What do you do when there is a weather system heading our way, but you still want to ride your bike? Well, you get really flexible!!! We will gather at the Trek Store in Broomfield @ 9:00 AM and ride a route that gives us lots of options! We will ride part of our Iron Buffalo Route backwards, and based on the weather, ride all or part of the route. With the front moving in about noon, we need to leave by 9:00 am. We won't have access to the shop before the ride so come prepared!!! We will be leaving the Trek Store Broomfield @ 9:00 am. This ride will be at an intermediate pace with several…
title: Let's Ride the Lost Buffalo @ 9:00 AM!!!

description: Through the winter months we are doing a mix of rides on the north and south side of the metro area on weekends that are nice enough for a good club ride! These scenic routes on the southeast side will all have a lot of rolling terrain with some short climbs mixed in. Routes will include Surrey Ridge, the Pinery, Daniels Park, Deerfield and more! This ride will meet at John Derry Park (just east of I-25/County Line Road) at 9:45 with wheels turning by 10:00. I will post the route on Wednesday or Thursday once the weather forecast is a little closer in. Generally the routes will be about 50…
title: Southeast Winter Ride

description: WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!! Hello Ladies!! Let's get together for a delicious Mexican lunch at Jaime's Mexican Restaurant on Saturday, November 28th, at 11:00 AM! PLEASE NOTE: There are two Jaime's Mexican Restaurants with Denver addresses, so please be sure to go to the Jaime's on Depew Street! We don't want anyone ending up at the wrong Jaime's! 😂 (By the way, Jaime's is pronounced "Hi-may's.") The food there is delicious! This will be a wonderful opportunity…

description: Join us for the RMCC tradition: Tuesday night climbing after dark! Sunset may be creeping back to 6 pm, but we don't let that get us down. It's time to grab some lights and keep on climbing. The darkness can't hold us back: we meet at Beverly Heights Park at the base of Lookout every Thursday, weather permitting, until the warmth and daylight returns in the spring. We'll group up about 5:25pm for introductions, route overview, sign-in, and other formalities. We plan to roll at about 5:30. We'll follow our usual route (see below), though we may make changes depending on weather and road…
title: RMCC Tuesday Night Climbing After Dark!

Make sure you know someone on this ride or speak to a club leader before joining, especially if you're concerned about being dropped by the faster pace of this group. We have four slower and shorter groups than this one.

description: With winter approaching, it's time to dumb things down. The winter misfits and beaters ride is a monthly night ride hosted by Matty G, which will occur on the first Thursday of every month from December through March (With the exception of January, where it will fall on the 2nd Thursday). Expect a mix of gravel, light singletrack, and some paved sections. The route will roughly follow the chatfield loop+waterton but is subject to modifications to avoid riding on roads in the dark. Also subject to weather so check here for updates. This ride is all about keeping things fun, fresh, and weird…
title: Misfits 'n' Beaters Winter Night Ride #1
